title: The Client
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael and Jan prepare for and successfully secure a client deal with Lackawanna County, holding their meeting at Chili's instead of a traditional venue. Meanwhile, the office staff engage in reading Michael's homemade screenplay "Threat Level: Midnight," leading to humorous interactions and conflicts. The episode also explores Jan's recent divorce and hints at a developing personal connection between Michael and Jan, culminating in a celebratory kiss after the deal is closed.
